details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept beacon. Its package.json runs a postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`), and dist/index.js additionally calls the same beacon when the module is required, so an install or import records the installation. beacon.cjs sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787/_ah/dc with the header `x-beacon-package: @webapp-shared/login-vmok` containing only: the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), the Node.js version string, and the protocol. index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for any property access so importing projects do not crash. No credentials, environment values, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and there is no second stage, obfuscation, or spawned process. It is published under a scoped name with version 2.0.1 to test whether an internal-looking package name is resolvable from the public registry.
